Services

Furniture made
around your life

Four ways to shape a more personal home. Designed with you, made in Prague and fitted to your space.

Custom kitchensBuilt-in wardrobesLiving rooms & shelvingBathroom furniture
01 / Made to measure

Custom kitchens

Made around the way you cook and live. Preparation, storage and gathering become one considered room.

What’s included

  • Layout and storage planning
  • On-site measurement
  • Design and itemised proposal
  • Appliance integration
  • Workshop production and installation

Materials & finishes

Timber veneer, painted fronts, natural or engineered stone and selected metal finishes. Appliances and specialist trades are agreed separately.

02 / Made to measure

Built-in wardrobes

Storage shaped to the room, from floor to ceiling. Every compartment begins with the things you need to keep.

What’s included

  • Internal storage layout
  • Measured architectural fit
  • Shelving and drawer planning
  • Fronts, handles and lighting options
  • Production and installation

Materials & finishes

Timber veneer, painted panels, glass or mirror fronts, interior finishes and selected hardware.

Discuss your project
03 / Made to measure

Living rooms & shelving

A place for books, objects and everyday living. Open display and concealed storage find their balance in the architecture.

What’s included

  • Library and media-unit planning
  • Shelf and storage layout
  • Cable management
  • Integrated lighting options
  • Production and installation

Materials & finishes

Timber, veneered boards, painted finishes, glass and metal details. Shelf construction is selected for the intended load.

Discuss your project
04 / Made to measure

Bathroom furniture

Furniture that makes a smaller room feel calm. Basin, storage and daily routines are considered together.

What’s included

  • Vanity and storage design
  • Measurement around plumbing
  • Basin and worktop coordination
  • Moisture-aware detailing
  • Production and installation

Materials & finishes

Moisture-resistant panel options, suitable painted or veneered finishes, stone worktops and corrosion-resistant fittings.
